notes.title: ANARIA: Reborn – now on Steam!
notes.content:
ANARIA: Reborn is here!
The complete remake of the first game – with vastly improved visuals, full optimization, and support for 10 languages.

🕯️ Official launch: Winter 2025
🕹️ Rebuilt from the ground up for the most intense horror experience.

👉 Add to your Wishlist now:

notes.title: Resolution and Enemy
notes.content:
Added support for resolutions up to 4K (3840x2160)

Adjusted enemy AI: enemy is now slightly easier to avoid/detect

notes.title: A New Beginning: Anaria Is Getting a Full Remake
notes.content:
📢 Upcoming Update & Roadmap for Anaria
Hey everyone, thank you so much for playing Anaria and for all the feedback so far!
Your support means the world to me — as a solo indie dev, every comment helps shape the future of the game.

🛠️ Next Update – Full Remake Incoming!
I'm currently working on a complete remake of Anaria, rebuilding it from the ground up with:

Major performance optimizations

Improved visuals and mechanics

All known bugs fixed

This will be the definitive version of the current chapter.

🎮 After That – Bonus DLC Minigame
As a creative bonus, a small standalone DLC Minigame will follow — something fresh, eerie and experimental for the fans of twisted ideas.

📖 And Later – Chapter II
Once the remake and DLC are done, I’ll begin working on Chapter 2, continuing Anaria’s dark story in new terrifying directions.
